summary.text: Dale Crafts is the Republican candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 97, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race with no incumbent.
He previously represented District 56 in the Maine House from 2008 to 2016.

paragraphs.text: Crafts's Ballotpedia profile lists his profession as business owner.
He assumed office in the Maine House in 2008 representing District 56 and left in 2016.
He served on the Inland Fisheries and Wildlife Committee in each session from 2009 through 2015, and was its ranking minority member in the 2015 session.
Crafts was a delegate from Maine to the 2016 Republican National Convention.
In 2020 he was the Republican candidate for Maine's 2nd Congressional District and lost to Democratic incumbent Jared Golden, 175,228 votes (46.9 percent) to 197,974 (53.0 percent).
In 2026 Crafts advanced from the June 9 Republican primary with 840 votes.
